items.label: Tamper-evident audit
items.description: Seal the audit trail in a hash chain, so changing or removing rows is detected.
items.long_description: A background task numbers new audit rows and links each to the one before, and signs a checkpoint now and then. Verify with `aether --audit-verify --org <database>`. Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Checkpoint every (rows)
items.description: A signed checkpoint is made after this many sealed rows.
items.long_description: Also made when the last one is older than the time below. Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Checkpoint every (seconds)
items.description: A signed checkpoint is made when the last one is this old.
items.long_description: Only when rows have been sealed since. Organizations can override the global default.
